svg.text: STAGE 530 · TOPIC 170 · P1053–P1054 · 🎉 HISTORIC STAGE 530 & TOPIC 170 DUAL MILESTONE!
Enterprise WebRTC/ICE RFC 7675 STUN Consent Freshness 30s Cease-TX & Jitter Guard
Deterministic Immediate Cease-Transmission + [4000, 6000]ms Jitter (P1053) & Off-Path ICMP TxID Verify + [15, 30]s Window (P1054)
❌ UNPROTECTED ICE CONSENT FRESHNESS
1. Post-Expiry RTP Leak & Unjittered STUN Flood
Consent Expired (>30s) -> 34 Unconsented SRTP Packets Leaked!
• Leaks AI voice audio into recycled carrier NAT UDP ports
• 1200ms or fixed 5000ms STUN timers cause synchronized bursts
2. Off-Path Spoofed ICMP Revocation & 90s Stale Window
Spoofed ICMP Port Unreachable -> Instant Call Drop ❌
• 5 active calls killed by off-path ICMP lacking 96-bit STUN TxID
• 90s expiration window violates RFC 7675 §5.1 30s ceiling
Production Impact Without P1053 / P1054
• Cross-subscriber audio bleed when NAT bindings recycle
• Trivial off-path ICMP DoS & SFU signaling microbursts
✅ STAGE 530 DETERMINISTIC GUARDRAILS (P1053–P1054)
P1053 (1,062nd Guard): Cease-TX & [4000, 6000]ms Jitter
action: "cease_unconsented_rtp_tx_and_clamp_stun_jitter_ms"
• Halts 100% of RTP/SRTP egress immediately on consent expiry
• Clamps unconsentedPostExpiryRtpPackets = 0
• Clamps stunConsentCheckIntervalMs in [4000, 6000]ms (1200 -> 4000ms)
Policy ID: P1053-WEBRTC-RFC7675-CONSENT-FRESHNESS-JITTER-AND-30S-CEASE-TRANSMISSION-GUARD
P1054 (1,063rd Guard): ICMP TxID Verify & [15, 30]s Window
action: "verify_icmp_inner_stun_txid_and_clamp_expiry_window_seconds"
• Rejects ICMP errors lacking matching 96-bit in-flight STUN TxID
• Clamps spoofedIcmpTriggeredCallDrops = 0
• Clamps consentExpirationWindowSeconds in [15, 30]s (90s -> 30s)
Policy ID: P1054-WEBRTC-RFC7675-OFF-PATH-ICMP-REVOCATION-VERIFICATION-AND-FAILURE-WINDOW-GUARD
